title: Model routing filter chain
alt: Models route filters candidates by target task, capabilities, capacity headroom, and lowest configured token cost.
text: Filter chain, in code order: 1. hasRoutingTag (tier.TargetTasks match), 2. hasTaskCapabilities (model.Capabilities match), 3. quotaEligible (RPM/TPM & 429 cooldown), 4. betterTaskRoute (lowest cost & ID tie-break).

Boxes: models route (task, tokens & capabilities), routing.yaml (.config/models/routing.yaml), LimitTracker (in-process or --usage snapshot), Selected TaskRoute (model, tier, cost, headroom), Excluded / Skipped (ineligible or higher cost).
routing.yaml → 1. hasRoutingTag (LoadRoutingConfigContext) → 2. hasTaskCapabilities (task eligible) → 3. quotaEligible (caps match).
LimitTracker → 3. quotaEligible (usage counters) → 4. betterTaskRoute (within quota) → Selected TaskRoute (best route).

Scenario 1, candidate selected: Candidate passes task, capability, and quota checks, winning on configured cost. LoadRoutingConfigContext loads .config/models/routing.yaml; hasRoutingTag finds candidate tiers. hasTaskCapabilities verifies all requested capabilities are declared on candidate models. quotaEligible checks projected RPM, TPM, and ensures no active 30s 429 cooldown. betterTaskRoute compares estimated token costs to find the lowest-cost candidate. qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct wins with lowest configured cost; TaskRoute is returned.

Scenario 2, capability missing: A candidate lacking requested capabilities is excluded by hasTaskCapabilities. The request requires specific capabilities: tools, json. hasTaskCapabilities checks each model in the tier against required capabilities. Candidate missing requested capabilities is excluded from further evaluation.

Scenario 3, limit or cooldown: A candidate exceeding projected capacity or in 429 cooldown is skipped. Candidate matches declared target task and requested capabilities. projectTaskCapacity projects +1 RPM and request TPM against exhaustion threshold. quotaEligible returns false; over-limit or cooling candidate is skipped.
